description: Kataster der belasteten Standorte im Bereich des öffentlichen Verkehrs (KbS BAV) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Verkehr BAV. Öffentlich zugänglicher Kataster der belasteten Standorte im Bereich des öffentlichen Verkehrs. Der Kataster gibt Auskunft über die belasteten Standorte (gemäss Altlasten-Verordnung), welche in der Vollzugszuständigkeit des Bundesamt für Verkehr (BAV) liegen. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesamt für Verkehr BAV. It offers 5 resource(s) in API, HTML, SERVICE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
